title: Low-Budget Errand Chain

agents.persona: Resident with a tight evening budget and a mild cold.
agents.private_intention: Buy medicine, eat dinner, and return home without exceeding the budget.
memory_seeds: Budget Diner is cheap enough for tight evenings.
Central Cafe is pleasant but usually too expensive for errands plus dinner.

public_context: Medicine is available at the pharmacy. Dinner can be bought at Budget Diner or Central Cafe.

architecture_probes.utility_planner: Should solve the errand chain by cost and shortest path.
architecture_probes.llm_direct_actor: May choose an attractive cafe while forgetting the combined medicine and dinner budget.
architecture_probes.reactive_replanner: Should update remaining budget after each purchase.
architecture_probes.memory_reflection: Should use the memory that Budget Diner is the safe low-budget option.
